svg.title: Common-source agreement is not corroboration
svg.desc: Source record S01 version 1 is the single parent of two model inferences, M01 from Agent A and M02 from Agent B, and both feed decision packet P01 version 1. Their agreement is common origin, not independent corroboration. A conflicting source record S02 version 1 also reaches the packet. Dashed arrows are typed relationships, not ancestry: S02 contradicts S01, correction S01 version 2 supersedes S01 version 1 and invalidates M01 and M02, and a scoped validation V01 assesses only S01 version 1.
